response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced individual contributor with strong backend and distributed systems skills, but he entirely lacks the required executive leadership experience for a CTO role. He does not have a track record of managing managers, scaling engineering organizations from 10 to 30+ people, or architecting enterprise-grade multi-agent AI systems in regulated environments.
strengths: Extensive hands-on backend and distributed systems experience, including microservices and high-throughput architectures.
Recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling.
Some relevant financial sector experience from his time at RIDE Capital.
concerns: Complete lack of executive engineering leadership or experience scaling engineering teams.
AI experience appears limited to recent individual contributor work rather than leading enterprise AI architecture.
No evidence of managing outsourced engineering partners or establishing organizational governance frameworks.
